outcome: umbilical cord blood CD34+ cell count
umbilical cord blood total nucleated cell count
viability of umbilical cord stem cells
finding: Women who underwent emergency caesarean section for fetal distress had a higher umbilical cord blood CD34+ cell count and total nucleated cell count compared to women who underwent emergency caesarean section for other indications.
mod_finding: Women who underwent emergency C-section for fetal distress had significantly higher CD34(+) counts and total nucleated cell counts in their umbilical cord blood compared to those who underwent emergency C-section for other reasons.
